intro: Perfected in Foundation School — compulsory for every new convert and new member. 6 classes over 6 weeks + graduation exam, prerequisite for leadership in the house of God. You are taught our Vision, sound doctrine, and how to live the Word daily — established in righteousness, walking in divine health, prosperity, and excellence. Hallelujah!

classes.title: The New Creation
classes.summary: Who the new creation is in Christ — your rights, righteousness, and recreated life. Regenerated spirit, renewed mind, disciplined body; functioning in dominion.

classes.title: The Holy Spirit
classes.summary: The Person and ministry of the Holy Spirit — being filled with the Spirit, fellowship of the Spirit, gifts of the Spirit, and divine enablement to minister with power.

classes.title: Christian Doctrine
classes.summary: Foundational doctrines of Christ: righteousness, sanctification, holiness, living faith, and deliverance — built on the infallible, efficacious Word.

classes.title: Evangelism & Cell Ministry
classes.summary: Soul-winning as your lifestyle and chariot — winning every man's world to Christ; the cell system as the Church's missionary and pastoral care structure.

classes.title: Christian Character & Prosperity
classes.summary: Character formation, prosperity principles, stewardship — succeeding God's way.

classes.title: The Local Assembly & Believers' LoveWorld
classes.summary: Universal vs local church, and Believers' LoveWorld order — LoveWorld Nation -> Zone -> Group -> Church -> Cell — your place in the Vision, fulfilling your divine assignment with excellence.

certificationNote: Teachers are hand-picked by the Pastor, verified by Zonal office, and recertified every 6 months. Attendance must be consistent — an interruption >3 months restarts the cycle.
